title: Oven Roasted Greek Grape Leaves Moussaka
description: A pungent and crumbly Greek dish featuring grape leaves and sashimi-cut ingredients, perfect for a festive dinner, this keto-friendly moussaka is a unique twist on traditional Greek cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the grape leaves by rinsing and cutting off the stems.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onion and garlic, ground lamb, feta cheese, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
To assemble the moussaka, begin with a layer of grape leaves, followed by a layer of the lamb mixture, and repeat until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of grape leaves on top.
Place the moussaka in a baking dish and bake for 45 minutes, or until the top layer of grape leaves is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the moussaka from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
